names.note: Name page 9200 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Василий (Эрекаев), иеромонах, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Василия». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE and a Cyrillic grep for «Эрекаев» over every `saint.json` returns nothing — the bare «Василий» was out of the question, three folders carrying it as a display name alone.

death.note: The day line closes «(1937)», one year for the whole company of eight; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 июля ст. ст. — «Прмч. Василия , прмцц. Анастасии и Елены , мчч. Арефы , Иоанна , Иоанна , Иоанна и мц. Мавры (1937).»

attestations.note: The first man of the day's eleventh entry, AN ENUMERATED COMPANY OF EIGHT, which BRIEF.md §4 makes eight folders; this draft holds all eight the line prints and no more. THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS for every one of them: no life page stands behind the entry. THE LINE AND HIS NAME PAGE DISAGREE ABOUT THE GRADE — the line heads him «Прмч.», venerable-martyr, and name page 9200 «сщмч.», hieromartyr. `venerable-martyr` is written from the line, `hieromonk` from the name page's rank, which is a fact and not a grade, and `hieromartyr` was NOT written; the disagreement is recorded and resolved nowhere. NO `office` IS WRITTEN — «Hieromonk» is not a string the locale packs were checked for and the rank stands in `types`. THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. The day page prints no hymn under any of the eight names.
